worldcombat.skill.irondefense.summary: Sharply raise Defense and resist knockback at the cost of movement speed. This Defense increase ends with the effect.
worldcombat.skill.irondefense.use.0: Quench the body into iron before a close-range gank
worldcombat.skill.irondefense.use.1: Hold position against knockback and refuse to be pushed off
worldcombat.skill.irondefense.use.2: Use the visible shell window to make the opponent spend time chipping it
worldcombat.skill.irondefense.descriptio: The shell raises Defense by %1$s level(s) for about %2$s.
While it holds, knockback resistance is greatly raised and movement speed drops.
worldcombat.skill.irondefense.timing: Self move, range %1$s blocks; after %2$s s of wind-up it spends %4$s PP, recovers for %3$s s and starts a %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.irondefense.growth.0: At level %1$s the shell extends to %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.irondefense.growth.1: At level %1$s the shell extends further to %2$s and the cooldown shortens to %3$s s.
worldcombat.skill.irondefense.preference: The companion considers cladding itself only when a threat is within this distance; larger means earlier preparation.
Below this health ratio the companion clads ahead of the shared order; higher enters the defensive stance earlier, lower only when nearly down.
